after_notes: Verified at 5224ef05c73d631f170bc90436a24d2d27566787: detector-gated live safety hardware proof joins independently validated SAFE-10, STR-006, PWR-002, and PWR-003 evidence for an accepted campaign, ordered production stop, complete rollback, ASIC/core-rail disable, consumed terminal state, cleanup, current tests, and redaction; see [SAFE-12 result](work-plans/20260820T052841Z-SAFE-12/RESULT.md), [summary](evidence/safe12-production-safe-stop/summary.md), and [Phase 28 summary](evidence/phase-28-hardware-evidence-and-checklist-promotion/summary.md). redaction_status: passed. exact_non_claims: fault-injected safe stop on hardware, per-step electrical timing or waveform measurement, power-loss interruption, automatic thermal or fan fault recovery, arbitrary profiles/pools, other boards/ASICs, unbounded mining, OTA/recovery, SAFE-13, and release readiness. The production 75 C trip, the VR temperature trip, a second trip after a restart, fan fault recovery, recovery across a reboot and the remaining exact_non_claims above still apply.
